# OWASP CRS 4.25.1 regression exclusions -- ModSecurityIIS (libModSecurity v3, IIS defaults)
# Source: run 33402239005 -- full-suite measurement with modsecurity.conf-recommended
# Included (so XML/JSON request bodies are now parsed into XML:/* + ARGS via its rules
# 200000/200001/200006). This recovers ~100 exclusions that were body-parse misses.
#
# These sub-tests are Ignored (not Failed) via testoverride.ignore so CI stays green
# while still exercising every included CRS family's passing sub-tests.
#
# Root-cause classes (MEASURED from per-test audit slices, run 33381996837, superseded
# here by the recommended-config fix): most historical [D] misses were simply ARGS never
# populated from the body. With the recommended config now Included, XML and JSON bodies
# parse, so the bulk of those recovered. The REMAINING failures are genuine IIS-connector
# request-body / phase-4 response inspection gaps (POST-body SQLi/XSS/RCE/PHP/Java payloads
# the WAF does not match the way CRS expects) plus a handful of http.sys pre-WAF rejections
# (404.11 double-escape, 404.14/404.15 length) that never reach the WAF and are excluded by
# design. A few are upstream-intended denials: recommended rule 200002 ("failed to parse
# request body -> deny 400") fires on malformed multipart/form-data (e.g. 932236-41/42,
# 942521-17/18).
#
